Caring for Mel

a field guide, for gentle hands
look around
Drag the empty air to orbit, or use the arrow keys. Scroll to lean in.
say hello
Bring your cursor near him slowly. Sudden movement reads as a swat — he will bolt.
pet him
Hover close and stroke in slow, small circles. Trust grows; hearts happen.
pick him up
Once he trusts you, press and hold on him a moment — he'll climb aboard. Carry him slowly and set him down anywhere. A drop onto the pillow is appreciated.
feed him
Drag the cucumber or carrot around the terrarium. When he's peckish, he'll find it and unfurl his proboscis.
neural view
Press N to see his connectome — the circuits light up with whatever he's doing right now.
His hologram uses real neuron locations and weighted connections from FlyWire FAFB v783. The activity is a connectome-constrained simulation, not a recording; Mel’s personality remains his own. The derived connectome data is CC BY-NC 4.0. This little world runs entirely in your browser. No flies were swatted.
